newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia raises May crude palm oil export tax.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia raises May crude palm oil export tax.

text.p: Indonesia has raised the export tax on crude palm oil to $47.32 a tonne in May from $41.08 in April, the finance ministry said on Monday.
The tax on RBD palm olein was raised to $68.60 in May from $54.60, while that on RBD palm oil was increased to $53.04 from $43.68, the ministry said.
The export tax on crude olein was raised to $66.95 in May from $58.10 in April.

The export taxes, introduced in September 1994, are based on a composite average of international prices in the last two weeks of the previous month and are aimed at ensuring sufficient supply and stable prices in the domestic market.
